descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Vânzări cu amănuntul
Digital. Inspiring. Unique. 
 Tchibo is one of the ten largest eCommerce companies in Germany. We could never have attained this standing without the courage to constantly rethink the old ways. In the digital world at Tchibo, we work with the latest technologies to develop sustainable and effective solutions. 
 Do you want to help us do this? Enrich our team with your fresh ideas!
 In the Presentation team the experience of buying products is in the center of the daily work. We are an innovative, cross-functional and agile team providing one of the most business critical parts of the Tchibo e-commerce platform with our microservices.
 Key Responsibilities: 
Designing, building, running, enhancing and maintaining our customer centric microservices in close collaboration with the team.
Plan and develop end-to-end microservices with a full technology stack (frontend, backend, cloud infrastructure, and CI/CD), write clean and high-quality code on a daily basis. 
Ensure a high standard of quality by doing code reviews, pair programming and instant feedback loops and using best practices (e.g. style guidelines, testing, security, performance, and resilience).
Work on cutting-edge projects and collaborate with a diverse group of professionals, including designers, developers, architects, testers and project managers.
Personal development and further education possibilities. e.g. taking part in conferences, internal Tchibo conventions and online education programs.
 Your profile: 
You have a successfully completed degree in computer science/business informatics or have a comparable qualification.
You have at least 3 years practical experience in software development / architecture and bring a passion for new technologies.
You are looking for a new opportunity and are interested in building and operating complex web applications from start to finish using a wide range of technologies and programming languages in a modern cloud environment.
You are self-motivated, proactive, and enthusiastic about solving complex problems.
You are a creative thinker who loves working on challenging projects and enjoys a fast-paced and dynamic work environment.
You are a true team player and are keen to play a role in cross-functional teams, always working together in an agile way (SCRUM/KANBAN).
You're able to handle multiple tasks simultaneously, manage your time effectively, and stay up to date with the latest trends and technologies.
 Qualifications: 
Experience in developing web applications with Vue.js 3 and Nuxt 3 / Vite would be a plus.
First experiences in software architecture, design and development of self-contained microservices is what sets you apart.
You are familiar with cloud development, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP), their products like (CloudSQL, Pub/Sub, and GKE), DevOps, Terraform, Kubernetes.
If you are interested in data privacy and software security topics and you bring some first experiences our team is the perfect fit for you.
You are confident in writing and speaking in English.
You have in-depth knowledge of one or more modern programming language preferred Kotlin, Java and JavaScript / TypeScript.
Professional software development experiences with Git and automation (CI/CD).
Experience with object relational databases, knowledge of how to write SQL scripts
Knowledge of web development. You are willing to take the ownership for development and operation of one or more microservices.
 Your benefits: Together we stay different. 
Work-Life Balance: Flexible, hybrid working policy with 26 vacation days + your birthday off.
Benefits: Monthly transport allowance (80 RON/month), meal tickets, and health/life insurance.
Personal Perks: Free Tchibo coffee for home, and the chance to work on cutting-edge technology in a dynamic environment.
Innovative Work Environment: We are a forward-thinking team where creativity and innovation are encouraged. You will collaborate with talented professionals and contribute to building Tchibo Tech, shaping the future of our technology landscape.
Inclusive Culture: A diverse and inclusive workplace where your unique perspectives and ideas are valued, fostering a culture of collaboration and mutual respect.
Impactful Work: Our meaningful projects make a real difference, driving positive change and contributing to the success of Tchibo.
